description: Port of SQLFluff 4.4.0's RF06 (references.quoting) with default prefer_quoted_identifiers=false, prefer_quoted_keywords=false and case_sensitive=true: an identifier is unnecessary quoted when it is a valid naked identifier, is not a keyword, and already has the dialect's unquoted casefold. This draft uses ANSI's upper-case casefold; PostgreSQL's lower-case casefold is a declared divergence.

violation.message: Unnecessary quoted identifier; use the unquoted form.
